notes: Official TRASSIR (DSSL) IP-camera user manuals give rtsp://[login]:[password]@[ip]:[rtsp port]/live/main (main), /live/sub (sub) and, on 4.x firmware, /live/mobile (third stream); default RTSP port 554. This covers the mainstream TR-D fixed-camera lines listed in those manuals (TR-D1xxx/2xxx/3xxx/4xxx/7xxx/8xxx/9xxx 2-6 MP models and revisions v2-v7, TR-D2B/2D/2S/4B/4D/4S, TR-D6124IR10 v3, TR-D6154IR10 v3, TR-DP8422ZIR2). Two product lines use other paths and carry their own URL on the camera record: the 8 MP line documented in the QTR manual (https://www.dssl.ru/upload/iblock/758/QTR_UM-_4_.pdf — TR-D2181IR3 v2/v3, TR-D2183IR6 v2/v3, TR-D2183ZIR6 v2/v3, TR-D3181IR3 v2/v3, TR-D3183ZIR3 v2/v3, TR-D8181IR3 v2/v3, TR-D2281WDIR4, TR-D2283WDZIR7, TR-D3281WDIR4, TR-D3283WDZIR3, TR-D4281WDIR2, TR-D8281WDIR4) uses rtsp://[ip]:[port]/mode=real&idc=1&ids=1 (ids=1 main, 2-3 sub), and the speed-dome line documented in https://www.dssl.ru/upload/iblock/0ff/TR_DTRsd_UM-_1_.pdf (TR-D5123IR3, TR-D5124, TR-D6224IR10, TR-D6254, TR-D6254IR15 and its rev.2 — the later TR-D6254IR15 v3 is not in that manual) uses /cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0 (main) / subtype=1 (sub). Models that no TRASSIR manual lists by name (dual-light DL models, TR-D23xx/33xx/83xx, 8 MP v3/v7 revisions, v3 speed domes, TR-W Wi-Fi, TR-Lite, TR-P) are not individually documented — confirm the path in the camera web UI (Network > RTSP) or via ONVIF.
